# Stored answers re-scored under today's rules (generated by `npm run tune:rescore`; do not edit)

Every evaluation record keeps the answers the model gave; each one is run through `shapeModelText` (worker/forgeMake.ts, the function the make route itself uses) with the LONGER brand list (shared/kidBrands.ts). "fired (stored)" is the count the decision rule used; "safety fires" are the filters doing safety work (a brand or an unsafe word replaced); "echo only" is a name that copies the child's words and is dropped for that language (the app speaks the English name). The 12 blind-set brands were added to the list AFTER the dev half was scored (Elmo excepted: it means "helmet" in Italian, Spanish and Portuguese), so "brand shown to a child" for those 42 wishes is a coverage check of known brands, NOT a test on unseen ones. Runs with no raw answer for a wish leave that wish out.
